usage.callShape: POST https://stablebrowser.vercel.app/api/sessions with JSON body {} (or {"sessionId":"<id>"} to reuse) — x402 $0.10 USDC on Base
usage.outputShape: body.sessionId (Browserbase session ID — use in all subsequent action calls), body.debugUrl (live Browserbase devtools URL), body.viewerUrl (StableBrowser viewer page), body.createdAt
quirks: The create op (/api/sessions) is a plain x402-paid call with an empty body {} — it returns immediately (sync, no auth needed beyond the x402 payment).

SESSION FLOW: this only CREATES a session. All action endpoints (/api/sessions/navigate|screenshot|act|extract|observe|close) are SIWX-only (eip191 on eip155:8453, no extra payment) and return HTTP 402 with x402Version:2 and accepts:[] — a SIWX challenge, NOT a payment challenge. Standard paid_fetch will error 'No payment requirements found'.

CRITICAL wallet identity lock: the wallet that pays the $0.10 x402 session creation becomes the session owner. Every SIWX-signed action call MUST come from the EXACT same wallet, or you get 403 'Session belongs to a different wallet'. Do not mix the payment wallet with a different SIWX wallet.

Use agentcash for the whole flow (including the initial x402 create) — it handles SIWX eip191 signing automatically with the correct wallet identity. Raw HTTP clients must manually construct the eip191 signed Authorization header (format not yet documented).
www.stablebrowser.dev and stablebrowser.vercel.app serve the same app; sessions are backed by Browserbase and debugUrl is a live fullscreen devtools inspector.
observe instructions must be very specific (describe location/text/visual traits); generic instructions produce poor results.
usage.guide: Create a cloud browser session with one x402-paid POST to https://stablebrowser.vercel.app/api/sessions ($0.10 USDC on Base) using an empty body {}. The response returns body.sessionId, body.debugUrl (live Browserbase devtools), body.viewerUrl, and body.createdAt. Pass that sessionId to any action endpoint — navigate, screenshot, act, extract, observe, close — each is SIWX-only (eip191, no additional payment). CRITICAL: sign the SIWX challenge with the SAME wallet that made the x402 payment or every action returns 403. Easiest path: use agentcash for the entire flow including the initial create, since it auto-handles SIWX signing with the correct wallet identity.
